Name: Guinea Pig Pet for Alternative Textures
Author: Joltemon
Description:
Adds a cute guinea pig to the game

Replaces the pet cat

Requires the Alternative Textures mod to work

How to use:
Buy the scissors item from Robin's shop (will not be available if Alternative Textures is not downloaded)
Click the pet cat and choose the guinea pig from the menu

Also compatible with the additional pet cats from Entoarox's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2274]More Animals[/url]
